text: Employee servicing equipment without energy isolation.
Employee is servicing the packaging line without isolating hazardous energy; the line is still powered.
The point of operation on the punch press is unguarded and the operator's hands enter the die area while it is running.
A worker is on a scaffold platform about 12 feet above the ground with an open side that has no guardrail or personal fall arrest system.
An extension cord in use at the workbench has damaged insulation with exposed copper conductors and is still plugged in.
Employees in the grinding area are exposed to a measured 92 dBA 8-hour TWA with no hearing conservation program.
